neighbours.label: a person's whereabouts or doings during a stretch while something else is looked after or keeps running without them (while you're away, at work, on a trip; go out and it finishes itself); the 'while you're…' frame counts even at home; not plain travel or motion 'away'
neighbours.short: being away while things carry on
fire: The automatic feeder keeps the fish fed while we're sitting in the living room.
The robot vacuum cleans the whole floor while you're at work.
Our neighbor waters the plants while we're on vacation in Portugal.
Just set the slow cooker in the morning, go out, and dinner finishes itself.
The backup runs overnight while you sleep, so you never have to think about it.
A sitter will look after the dog while we're away for the weekend.
Put the bread in the machine, head to the gym, and it bakes itself by the time you're back.
The camera lets you check on the cat while you're at the office.
quiet: Load the dishwasher, stand next to it, and watch the cycle finish.
The robot vacuum is loud, so I run it myself and follow it room to room.
We watered the plants ourselves every morning before breakfast.
I stood by the slow cooker all afternoon, stirring the dinner by hand.
The backup failed last night because the drive was full.
We walked the dog together along the river this weekend.
I kneaded the dough by hand and stayed beside the oven while it baked.
The cat jumped onto the office desk and knocked over a pen.

predictions: Blind test (label-only second author). Expect most fire items to clear 0.20; the 'stayed beside the oven while it baked' near miss is the riskiest.
notes: Feeder of bonsai1/L19/N9953+ chosen from the resident attribution ranking (play step OOM'd twice). Solver leak: the 'while we're ...' frame fires even when the person is home (0.65), so the label names it. Literal motion 'away' (sailed/walked away) and plain travel read near zero in probes.
